request_text: Pass 2 pre-merge review of PR #186 after fold

evidence_ref: debugger-debbie pass-2 pre-merge lens on PR #186 @c8bbfaf (fold of pass-1). Report-only, no edits. Browser-measured in Chromium (playwright 1.62) all six claimed fixes: (1) sticky border VERIFIED identical #353C48 1px at scrollTop 0 and 117; border-collapse:separate caused NO doubled borders, NO gaps, identical 36px row heights and identical 1px inter-row separators; (2) marker alt-text VERIFIED - AX name 'What changed in this release?' clean, pixel-identical render to content:'@' in normal/forced-dark/forced-light, LinkText recolor intact; (3) z-index:1 VERIFIED against tbody tr{position:relative}, and A/B vs z-index:auto shows no new over-painting of later positioned siblings; (4) hover band works on BOTH parities on collapsed tables but is ENTIRELY ABSENT on the sticky-header table; (5) region/tabindex triad still present on a non-overflowing authored narrow exemplar; (6) stylelint gate VERIFIED - permits the six system colours on longhands, rejects border-left-color:#ff0000, but does not scope them to forced-colors media. NEW HIGH findings: border-collapse:separate makes CSS ignore all tr borders, killing both the hover band and the forced-colors zebra on sk-data-table--sticky-header; and the new base rule border-left:3px solid transparent is force-recoloured to CanvasText on EVERY row under forced-colors, so the nth-child(even) zebra substitute is now a no-op in both HC schemes. Also: docs/contributing/adding-a-component.md still carries the superseded shorthand/CanvasText guidance at this head while two changed CSS files cite it as canonical and plan.md claims all five places fixed.
